parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, run_id: $json.run_id, task_id: $json.task_id, started_async: true, logs_dir: 'workflows/project/logs/automation_runs/' + $json.run_id } }}

parameters.command: ={{ 'cd "' + $('Parse Params').first().json.project_root + '" && bash workflows/project/n8n/run-cursor-task.sh --task-pack "' + $('Merge TaskPack').first().json.task_pack_path + '" --prompt-file "' + $('Build Prompt').first().json.prompt_path + '" --task-type "' + $('Parse Params').first().json.task_type + '" --complexity "' + $('Parse Params').first().json.complexity + '" --model-override "' + $('Parse Params').first().json.model_override + '" 2>&1' }}

={{ 'cd "' + $('Parse Params').first().json.project_root + '" && git commit -m "' + $('Parse Params').first().json.task_id + ': ' + ($('Parse Params').first().json.title || 'auto task').replace(/"/g, '\\"').slice(0, 60) + ' [run:' + $('Parse Params').first().json.run_id + ']" 2>&1' }}
